card.name: Digits in Australian classification codes
card.fires_on: Digits and punctuation inside Australian research-classification codes (FoR/SEO codes such as 13 EDUCATION > 1302) and nearby Australian government text. It fires on a digit partway through a code number.

modes.label: Digits in FoR/SEO codes
modes.description: A digit inside a numeric subject code that is followed by an uppercase field name like EDUCATION.

modes.label: Australian government text
modes.description: Punctuation or small words in Australian government or statistics references, such as times and committee names.

card.plain: It marks digits inside Australian research subject codes, plus a few other items in Australian government text.
